name: kxtrumpout27
title: Will Donald Trump announce or undergo departure as President (excluding death) before the market date?
settlement: Resolves Yes if Donald Trump leaves office before January 20, 2029. An announcement that he will leave office within the next year also counts. An acknowledgement that he will leave solely because of the scheduled end of a mandated term limit does not count. If he leaves solely because of death, the market settles at the last traded price before death, or by Outcome Review Committee determination.
decideContext: Estimate how a news item shifts the probability, in percentage points, that Trump resigns, is removed, or announces a departure within a year, before the stated deadline (2027, 2028 or Jan 20, 2029). Death alone does not trigger Yes, and a normal end of term does not count.
